titles.title: Sgt. Alfredo Freddy Gonzalez Memorial Veterans’ Hospital Act
Sgt. Alfredo Freddy Gonzalez Memorial Veterans’ Hospital Act
To authorize the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to construct a hospital under the jurisdiction of the Department of Veterans Affairs in the Rio Grande Valley sector, Texas.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Health.

bill.summary:
Sgt. Alfredo "Freddy" Gonzalez Memorial Veterans’ Hospital Act
This bill authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to construct a hospital under its jurisdiction in the Rio Grande Valley sector of Texas. Such hospital must be designated as the Sgt. Alfredo “Freddy” Gonzalez Memorial Veterans’ Hospital.
